durable_files.notes: 1999 Main Report Table 2.10 religion by province (+ national), transcribed from the print-volume scan received from Guy Lavender Forsyth 2026-07-06 (scan sha256 9cde4182…, git-ignored at data/raw/vu_census_guy/). Every row sums exactly to its total; provinces sum to the national row; national matches 2020 AR Table 30 (its refuse-to-answer 2,374 = do-not-want-to-say 320 + not-stated 2,054). Island rows in the scan await transcription. Relocated from the public repo to the private research tier 2026-07-07 per the data-access design (attributed-use licence class; JB-ratified). Earlier revisions remain in public git history; noted, not rewritten.

2020 T3.5: nation, urban/rural, 2 municipalities, 6 provinces (rural), 64 area councils; 14 categories + total. Published cells carry +/-1-2 internal inconsistencies (perturbation); verified against the PDF text layer. Relocated from the public repo to the private research tier 2026-07-07 per the data-access design (attributed-use licence class; JB-ratified). Earlier revisions remain in public git history; noted, not rewritten.

2009 T3.5: nation, urban/rural, 2 municipalities, 6 provinces (incl urban), 64 islands; 12 categories + total. All rows sum exactly to stated totals. Relocated from the public repo to the private research tier 2026-07-07 per the data-access design (attributed-use licence class; JB-ratified). Earlier revisions remain in public git history; noted, not rewritten.

Project derivation: 2020 provinces restored to the 2009 basis (Shefa+Port Vila, Sanma+Luganville). Reproduces published T31 shares within 0.05pp on 77 of 78 cells. Relocated from the public repo to the private research tier 2026-07-07 per the data-access design (attributed-use licence class; JB-ratified). Earlier revisions remain in public git history; noted, not rewritten.
